name: ck-tools
description: Optional toolkit for Claude Code: utility skills for dependency upgrades, audits, snapshots and other repo-level chores, plus a band above the prompt with a status row (branch, diff, model, context, session time) your weekly plan limit and pace, and a warning when disk space runs short. Designed to coexist with ck-code without overlapping its spec-driven workflow.

usage_band.title: Plan-limit band
usage_band.description: Show the weekly limit, your pace and the reset time above the prompt.

status_row.title: Status row
status_row.description: Show the git branch and diff, model, context fill and session time above the prompt.

usage_alerts.title: Plan-limit toasts
usage_alerts.description: Toast once per weekly window when its use crosses a threshold, and once when the pace runs it out before the reset.

usage_alert_at.title: Plan-limit toast thresholds
usage_alert_at.description: Comma-separated percentages that each toast once per window, such as 80,95.

disk_alert.title: Disk-space warning
disk_alert.description: Check free disk space now and then, and show a segment above the prompt plus one toast when it runs short, pointing at /ck-tools:disk-clean.

disk_alert_free_gb.title: Disk-space warning threshold (GB)
disk_alert_free_gb.description: Warn under this many GB free; red under a quarter of it.

disk_check_every.title: Disk-space check period
disk_check_every.description: How often free space is checked across all sessions: hour, day, week or month. While space is short it is checked hourly.

update_check.title: Update check
update_check.description: Toast once and show a row above the prompt when the marketplace serves a newer version of this plugin.
